evidence.excerpt: Radulović is interested in longer-term collaborative projects that involve real hardware from industrial partners rather than purely simulation-focused studies. Her scanning bench is available for external use on a cost-recovery basis when faculty teaching commitments permit. She is currently supervising two doctoral students expected to defend in 2026–2027.
